book_name: 会心之语·专八真题讲座答案词（2011-2024）

words.tr: 短语. 超越信息本身；在信息之外的深层含义或隐含意义
words.ex: The meaning was beyond the message.
words.ex_cn: 含义超出了字面信息。
words.en: Beyond the message refers to the deeper meaning, implications, or subtext that are not explicitly stated in the words used, requiring interpretation to understand the full intent or significance.

words.tr: phrase. 在上下文中；在特定背景或情境下；结合语境地
words.ex: He used the word 'in context' to explain the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他用‘在上下文中’这个词来解释意思。
words.en: In the specific situation or setting where something is being discussed or considered, rather than in isolation.

words.tr: 短语. 根据上下文而定；视情况而定
words.ex: The meaning changes, depending on context.
words.ex_cn: 意思根据上下文而变化。
words.en: Depending on the specific situation or circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 消息的上下文；指信息传递时所处的语言、情境或背景环境，用于帮助理解消息的真实含义
words.ex: The context of message helps us understand its meaning.
words.ex_cn: 消息的上下文帮助我们理解它的含义。
words.en: The situation or background in which a message is communicated.

words.tr: phrase. 上下文；语境；背景
words.ex: The context of the story helps us understand the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的背景帮助我们理解其含义。
words.en: The circumstances, setting, or background information that helps explain the meaning of a situation, word, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 发生了什么事？（用于询问当前情况或事件）
words.ex: What's happening? Why is everyone running?
words.ex_cn: 发生什么事了？为什么大家都在跑？
words.en: The current events or situation taking place.

words.tr: phrase. 感官参与更强烈的；感觉投入更多的
words.ex: The movie caused heavier sensory involvement from the audience.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影让观众产生了更强烈的感觉投入。
words.en: A greater degree of physical or perceptual engagement with the senses.

words.tr: phrase. 与人亲近的程度；亲密关系
words.ex: He values closeness to people in his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他在日常生活中重视与人的亲近。
words.en: The state of being physically or emotionally near to other people.

words.tr: phrase. 身体语言；肢体语言
words.ex: He smiles and nods, that is positive body language.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑并点头，这是积极的肢体语言。
words.en: The conscious and unconscious movements and postures by which attitudes and feelings are communicated.

words.tr: adj. 多样的；多种的；
words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.tr: adj. 多慢性的
words.ex: He has a poly-chronic condition affecting his heart, lungs, and joints.
words.ex_cn: 他患有影响心脏、肺和关节的多慢性疾病。
words.en: adj. Involving or relating to multiple chronic conditions or diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 在消息本身之中；在信息本身里
words.ex: The answer is in message itself.
words.ex_cn: 答案就在消息本身中。
words.en: Contained within the actual text or content of the message.

words.tr: phrase. 在消息中；在信息里
words.ex: The word 'help' is in the message.
words.ex_cn: 单词'help'在消息中。
words.en: Contained within the actual text or content of the message.

words.tr: phrase. 在事件中；在……场合下；如果发生……的话
words.ex: He stayed calm in event of the fire.
words.ex_cn: 在火灾发生时，他保持了冷静。
words.en: used to say that something will happen if another thing happens

words.tr: phrase. 不顾周围环境；无论周遭如何
words.ex: He sleeps soundly regardless of surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 他不管周围环境如何都能睡得很香。
words.en: Without regard to the surrounding environment or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 独立于语境的；不受上下文影响的
words.ex: The meaning is independent of context.
words.ex_cn: 这个意思与上下文无关。
words.en: Not influenced by or dependent on the surrounding situation.

words.tr: phrase. 这条信息；该消息
words.ex: The message was short and clear.
words.ex_cn: 这条信息简短而清晰。
words.en: The communication or information being conveyed.

words.tr: phrase. 信息本身；消息本身
words.ex: The message itself was very clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息本身非常清楚。
words.en: The core content or meaning of a communication.

words.tr: phrase. 言语或行为
words.ex: His words and actions show he is honest.
words.ex_cn: 他的言辞和行为表明他是诚实的。
words.en: Verbal expressions or physical deeds used to convey meaning.

words.tr: 你所说的话；你讲的内容
words.ex: I believe what you say.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你所说的话。
words.en: The specific verbal content of an utterance.

words.tr: 你所做的事；你的行为或职责
words.ex: I admire what you do to help others.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩你所做的一切来帮助他人。
words.en: The specific physical deeds performed.

words.tr: adj. 单时制的，专注于一项任务直到完成的
words.ex: He is mono-chronic and finishes one task before starting another.
words.ex_cn: 他是单时制的，完成一项任务后再开始另一项。
words.en: Relating to a culture or person that prefers to do one thing at a time and values punctuality.

words.tr: phrase. 一次；曾经
words.ex: I saw him one time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 我曾在公园里见过他一次。
words.en: Occurring on a single occasion; not repeated.

words.tr: n. 晚，迟
words.ex: He always faces punishment for his lateness.
words.ex_cn: 他总是因为迟到而受到惩罚。
words.en: The fact or quality of being late; tardiness.

words.tr: n.不守时
words.ex: His unpunctuality makes the meeting start late.
words.ex_cn: 他的不守时导致会议推迟开始。
words.en: The habit of being late or failing to meet scheduled times.

words.tr: phrase. 对时间的灵活性；在时间安排上的弹性
words.ex: He has flexibility with time to finish his work.
words.ex_cn: 他有灵活的时间来完成工作。
words.en: The ability to adjust or vary the timing of tasks or activities to accommodate different needs or preferences.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr: n. 重要性；
words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.tr: n. 重要性；意义；
words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.tr: phrase. 稀有的正式记录；罕见的正式档案
words.ex: The library keeps rare formal records from the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆保存着来自19世纪的稀有正式记录。
words.en: Documents or archives that are seldom created or preserved.

words.tr: phrase. 在已定义的条件下；在明确规定的状况下
words.ex: The experiment works under defined conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验在特定条件下有效。
words.en: In accordance with specified or limiting circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 系统的且客观的
words.ex: He is systematic and objective in his research.
words.ex_cn: 他在研究中是有条理且客观的。
words.en: Done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; methodical. Not influenced by personal feelings or opinions in considering and representing facts.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.tr: phrase. +adj.+n. 不同长度的；长度各异的
words.ex: The sticks are of different lengths.
words.ex_cn: 这些棍子长度不同。
words.en: Having varying measurements or durations.

words.tr: phrase. 随机分布地；无规律地分散
words.ex: The seeds are distributed randomly across the field.
words.ex_cn: 种子随机分布在整个田野上。
words.en: Spread or allocated in an irregular, non-systematic manner.

words.tr: phrase. 情境抽样；指在研究中从不同情境或环境中选取样本以获取更具代表性的数据
words.ex: He uses situation sampling to observe people in real life.
words.ex_cn: 他使用情境抽样来观察现实生活中的人们。
words.en: A method of observing and recording behavior as it naturally occurs in its real-world context.

words.tr: phrase. 是不同的；有差异的；不一样的
words.ex: This book is different from the one I read last week.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我上周读的那本不一样。
words.en: Not the same as something else; distinct in nature, quality, or characteristics.

words.tr: v. 不同；有异；
words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果的颜色不同。
words.en: To be unlike or dissimilar; to have a different character or quality.

words.tr: v. 变化；
words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If something varies or if you vary it, it becomes different or changed.

words.tr: n. 变化；变革；“change”的复数； v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: The changes in weather affect our mood.
words.ex_cn: 天气的变化影响我们的情绪。
words.en: Changes refer to the act or instance of making or becoming different, or the money returned when the amount given in payment is more than the cost.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: n. 目的；意图；
words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: phrase. 按照发生的情况；即时发生地
words.ex: He writes down the error as it occurs.
words.ex_cn: 他一出现错误就记下来。
words.en: In the exact moment or context in which something happens, without alteration.

words.tr: phrase. 有控制权；能够掌控
words.ex: He has control over the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他能控制这台机器。
words.en: Possesses the ability to direct or influence events, processes, or outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 有控制权的；能够掌控的
words.ex: The manager is having control over the project.
words.ex_cn: 经理对这个项目有控制权。
words.en: The state of having the power or authority to manage or direct something.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示拥有更多的控制权或掌控能力
words.ex: He has more control over his emotions.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的情绪有更多掌控。
words.en: To possess a greater degree of authority or influence over something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 正常出现的；自然发生的；在正常情况下存在的
words.ex: This bird is normally occurring in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟通常出现在森林里。
words.en: Happening regularly or typically in the course of normal events or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 在自然环境中；处于天然场景下
words.ex: The birds sing in natural setting.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在自然环境中歌唱。
words.en: In the authentic environment where events naturally take place, not in a lab.

words.tr: n. 方法；办法；
words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 检查理解；核实是否理解（通常用于教学或沟通中确认对方是否明白所讲内容）
words.ex: The teacher is checking understanding by asking simple questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问简单问题来检查理解情况。
words.en: The act of verifying that someone has correctly understood information or instructions.

words.tr: adj. 沉思的；反射的；
words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对信息进行反思的；对信息具有反思性的
words.ex: He is reflective on information before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定前会对信息进行反思。
words.en: Thinking deeply about data or facts to gain understanding and insight.

words.tr: adj. 令人困惑不解的； v. “puzzle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The puzzle was puzzling even for experts.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题即使对专家来说也令人困惑不解。
words.en: If something is puzzling, it is difficult to understand or explain because it is not clear or is confusing.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.tr: adj. 不熟悉的；陌生的；
words.ex: The town looked unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇对他来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: 短语，用于询问某物被阅读的内容或含义，中文：什么被读到 / 读的是什么
words.ex: What is read?
words.ex_cn: 什么是阅读？
words.en: The content, ideas, or material contained within written or printed text.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读材料；读物
words.ex: He bought some reading material for the plane trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为飞机旅行买了一些阅读材料。
words.en: Reading material refers to any written or printed material that is intended to be read, such as books, magazines, newspapers, and online articles.

words.tr: phrase. 全面且有条理的；包含广泛的并经过系统安排的
words.ex: He gave a comprehensive and organized presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一场关于气候变化的全面而有条理的演讲。
words.en: adj. Including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something; having a systematic or structured arrangement.

words.tr: phrase. 持续的理解与监控（指在交流或系统运行中持续不断地进行理解与监测的过程）
words.ex: The system requires constant understanding monitoring to detect errors in real time.
words.ex_cn: 该系统需要持续的理解与监控，以实时检测错误。
words.en: Continuous assessment of comprehension during a task or learning process.

words.tr: phrase. 监控他们的理解；监测他们的理解程度
words.ex: The teacher is monitoring their understanding by asking simple questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来监控他们的理解。
words.en: Actively observing and evaluating one's own or others' grasp of material.

words.tr: v. 与…不同；与…相异；
words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: 短语. 在结论上存在分歧；对结论有不同的看法
words.ex: The two studies differ in conclusion, leading to conflicting recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 这两项研究在结论上有所不同，导致建议相互矛盾。
words.en: To reach different final judgments or outcomes from the same information.

words.tr: phrase. 责怪别人；把过错推给别人
words.ex: He always blames others when things go wrong.
words.ex_cn: 当事情出错时，他总是责怪别人。
words.en: To attribute fault or responsibility to other people rather than oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 差劲的表现；低劣的性能；不佳的业绩
words.ex: The team's poor performance led to their elimination from the competition.
words.ex_cn: 团队表现不佳导致他们被淘汰出比赛。
words.en: Substandard or unsatisfactory achievement or execution of a task.

words.tr: phrase. 学校作业；学业任务
words.ex: She spends hours on her school work every evening.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都要花几个小时做学校作业。
words.en: Tasks, assignments, and academic activities required in an educational setting.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: phrase. 一种需求；要求
words.ex: The workers made a demand for higher wages.
words.ex_cn: 工人们要求提高工资。
words.en: A request or requirement that is considered necessary or urgent.

words.tr: phrase. 血压
words.ex: He checks his blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上测量血压。
words.en: The force that blood exerts against the walls of the blood vessels, especially the arteries, as it is pumped around the body by the heart.

words.tr: phrase. 压力的类型；应激的种类
words.ex: He has a type of stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种因工作太多而产生的压力。
words.en: A state of mental or emotional strain resulting from challenging circumstances.

words.tr: n. 工作
words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr: phrase. 早期信号；初期迹象
words.ex: The early signals of the economic recovery were evident in the rising stock prices.
words.ex_cn: 经济复苏的早期信号在不断上涨的股票价格中显而易见。
words.en: Initial signs or warnings that indicate a future event or problem.

words.tr: n. 记号；标志；
words.ex: The road has many signs for directions.
words.ex_cn: 这条路有很多方向标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. Signs can also be gestures or movements that you make with your hands or head to give someone information, instructions, or a warning. In addition, a sign can be an event, fact, or situation that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr: 名词短语，指锻炼与营养，涉及身体活动和饮食对健康的影响
words.ex: Exercise and nutrition are important for good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼和营养对健康很重要。
words.en: Physical activity and the intake of food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 接受失控的情况
words.ex: She learned to accept out-of-control situations and focus on what she could manage.
words.ex_cn: 她学会了接受失控的情况，专注于自己能管理的事情。
words.en: To acknowledge and come to terms with situations that cannot be controlled or managed.

words.tr: phrase. 接受无法改变的情况
words.ex: You need to learn to accept unchangeable situations and move forward with your life.
words.ex_cn: 你需要学会接受无法改变的情况，并继续你的生活。
words.en: To acknowledge and deal with circumstances that cannot be altered.

words.tr: phrase. 合理速度；适当速度；安全且符合规定的行驶速度
words.ex: He drove at a reasonable speed to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 他以合理的速度开车以确保安全。
words.en: A speed that is fair, moderate, and appropriate for the circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 意义的载体；传递意义的媒介或工具
words.ex: Words are carriers of meaning that allow us to communicate complex ideas.
words.ex_cn: 词语是意义的载体，使我们能够交流复杂的想法。
words.en: Elements (like words, symbols, or gestures) that convey or communicate ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 意义载体；承载意义的媒介或符号
words.ex: Books are meaning carriers that pass knowledge through generations.
words.ex_cn: 书籍是传递知识给后代的意义的承载者。
words.en: Entities or mediums that convey or hold significance, often used in the context of language, art, and communication to denote things that carry or transmit meaning.

words.tr: phrase. 语言的组成部分；语言要素（指语音、词汇、语法、语义等构成语言的基本成分）
words.ex: Understanding the parts of language is essential for learning any new language.
words.ex_cn: 理解语言的组成部分对于学习任何新语言都是必不可少的。
words.en: The components or elements that make up a language, including grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation.

words.tr: phrase. 其他功能；其他特点；其他特性
words.ex: This phone has other features like a flashlight and a voice recorder.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机还有其他功能，比如手电筒和语音录音器。
words.en: Additional characteristics or aspects that contribute to the overall nature of something.

words.tr: n. 节奏；
words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: phrase. 添加信息；增加资料
words.ex: He will add information to the report tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会在报告中添加信息。
words.en: To provide additional details or facts to make something clearer or more complete.

words.tr: phrase. 一个特定的主题；某个具体的学科或话题
words.ex: The book focuses on a particular subject that is rarely discussed in mainstream media.
words.ex_cn: 这本书专注于一个在主流媒体中很少讨论的特定主题。
words.en: A specific topic or area of study that is being discussed or considered.

words.tr: phrase. 知识或经验；指通过学习和实践获得的认知与技能
words.ex: His knowledge or experience in the field of engineering is extensive.
words.ex_cn: 他在工程领域的知识或经验非常丰富。
words.en: Familiarity or skill gained through direct observation, participation, or education.

words.tr: v. 重新解释( reinterpret的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is reinterpretating the old story in a new way.
words.ex_cn: 他正在以一种新的方式重新诠释这个古老的故事。
words.en: Giving a new or different interpretation to something, often to adapt it to a new context.

words.tr: v. 预言；“predict”的现在分词；
words.ex: He was predicting rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他当时预言明天会下雨。
words.en: To say that an event or action will happen in the future, especially as a result of knowledge or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 预测的类型；预言的种类
words.ex: He studies types of predictions in weather class.
words.ex_cn: 他在气象课上研究各种预测类型。
words.en: Various kinds of forecasts or statements about what is likely to happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: phrase. 辩证模型；指通过正题、反题与合题的辩证过程来解释事物发展或矛盾解决的理论框架
words.ex: He uses the dialectical model to explain change.
words.ex_cn: 他使用辩证模型来解释变化。
words.en: A theoretical framework that emphasizes the development of ideas through the conflict and reconciliation of opposing forces.

words.tr: phrase. 普遍且固定的；常见的并被确定的
words.ex: The rules are common and fixed for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则对所有学生来说都是通用且固定的。
words.en: Widely accepted and unchanging; not subject to variation or modification.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.tr: n. 反对；对立；
words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.tr: v. 提出理由证明；坚决主张；争吵；争吵，辩论( argue的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is arguing that exercise improves mental health.
words.ex_cn: 他提出理由证明锻炼能改善心理健康。
words.en: Arguing: (verb) Having a heated verbal disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 将争论视为一种表演；把论证看作是一种带有表演性质的行为或表现形式
words.ex: He treats his arguments as performances.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的论点当作表演。
words.en: Presenting ideas or viewpoints in a structured, persuasive manner, similar to a theatrical performance.

words.tr: phrase. 修辞模型；指用于分析或构建修辞策略的理论框架或范式
words.ex: He uses the rhetorical model to persuade his audience.
words.ex_cn: 他使用修辞模型来说服他的听众。
words.en: A framework or approach used to analyze or construct arguments, especially in speech or writing, focusing on the strategies of persuasion.

words.tr: adj. 具有参与特征的；
words.ex: The participatory meeting let everyone speak.
words.ex_cn: 这个具有参与特征的会议让每个人都能发言。
words.en: Involving or characterized by participation.

words.tr: v. 参与；“participate”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is participating in a school competition.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一个学校比赛。
words.en: Taking part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 参与者；参加者（特指某个活动或事件中的人）
words.ex: The participant answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位参与者迅速回答了问题。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in something.

words.tr: phrase. 参与；参加（活动、事件等）
words.ex: He is taking part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To participate or be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 被定制以适应；被裁剪以适合；根据……的需要进行调整
words.ex: The course is tailored to beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程是为初学者量身定制的。
words.en: To be designed or adapted to meet a particular need or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 供应伙食；迎合
words.ex: The café caters for breakfast and lunch.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆供应早餐和午餐。
words.en: To cater for something means to provide all the things that are needed or wanted for a particular purpose or event.

words.tr: phrase. + pron. + v. 我们如何争论；我们进行辩论的方式
words.ex: How we argue matters more than who wins.
words.ex_cn: 我们如何争论比谁赢更重要。
words.en: The methods, styles, and strategies used to present and support one's ideas or claims.

words.tr: phrase. 我们实际的行为；我们真实的行为表现
words.ex: Our actual conduct shows what we really believe.
words.ex_cn: 我们的实际行为展示了我们真正相信的东西。
words.en: The actual, real-world actions and behaviors that people exhibit, as opposed to what they say they do.

words.tr: n. 策略；战术；
words.ex: The coach changed his tactics to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 教练改变了策略以赢得比赛。
words.en: Tactics are the methods that you choose to use in order to achieve what you want in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 策略；战略；“strategy”的复数
words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 协商与合作；谈判与协作
words.ex: They started negotiation and collaboration to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他们开始谈判与合作来解决问题。
words.en: The process of discussing something with someone in order to reach an agreement, and the act of working together with someone to produce or create something.

words.tr: phrase. 死胡同；无结果的途径
words.ex: These narrow streets are theyre dead ends with no way out.
words.ex_cn: 这些狭窄的街道是死胡同，没有出路。
words.en: They are situations or options with no possible future development or success.

words.tr: 短语：没有解决办法；无解
words.ex: There's no solution for this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题没有解。
words.en: There is no way to solve the problem or find an answer.

words.tr: 没有进展；事情没有任何推进或改善
words.ex: There's no progress in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学作业没有任何进展。
words.en: No improvement or forward movement is being made.

words.tr: phrase. 在失败中学习；通过失败获得成长
words.ex: He keeps trying, learning with losing.
words.ex_cn: 他不断尝试，在失败中学习。
words.en: The process of gaining knowledge through failure or setbacks.

words.tr: n. 问题；“question”的复数；
words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.tr: n. 反对意见；反考虑
words.ex: He listed counter-considerations before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定之前列出了相反的考虑因素。
words.en: Considerations or arguments presented in opposition to a proposal or idea.

words.tr: n．反驳论点，反论：针对某一论点或观点提出的相反或不同的论点，用以质疑或驳斥原论点。
words.ex: He gave counter-arguments to the teacher's point.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师的观点提出了反驳。
words.en: Points or reasons presented against a particular idea or proposal.

words.tr: n. 反对的理由；异议；反对( objection的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He ignored all objections and continued his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了所有的反对理由，继续执行他的计划。
words.en: Expressions of disapproval or disagreement with something.

words.tr: phrase. 反对的理由；持相反意见的论点
words.ex: He gave arguments in opposition to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了反对新规定的理由。
words.en: Statements or reasons put forward to oppose a particular idea.

words.tr: 实现积极的效果；达成正面影响
words.ex: He achieved positive effects by exercising every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天锻炼取得了积极的效果。
words.en: To produce beneficial or favourable results.

words.tr: phrase. 养活自己；自食其力
words.ex: He works part-time to support himself.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职工作来养活自己。
words.en: To provide for one's own needs, especially financially.

words.tr: phrase. 自给自足的；依靠自己的力量维持生活的
words.ex: He is self-supported by doing part-time jobs.
words.ex_cn: 他靠做兼职工作自给自足。
words.en: To be self-supported means to be able to support oneself without relying on others, especially financially.

words.tr: phrase. 养活自己；自立；自我支撑
words.ex: You need to work to support yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你需要工作来养活自己。
words.en: To provide for your own needs, especially financially.

words.tr: v. 写下；示意； n. 签字；签署（文件等）；签署（文件等） v. 签字(sign的现在分词)；
words.ex: He is signing his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他正在纸上写下自己的名字。
words.en: The act of writing one's name on a document to show that you agree with its contents or that you were the person who wrote or created it.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr: phrase. 变得有读写能力；学会识字
words.ex: He wants to become literate so he can read signs.
words.ex_cn: 他想识字，以便能看懂标志。
words.en: To acquire the ability to read and write.

words.tr: n. 有读写能力；识字；
words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.tr: phrase. 不同但互补的；性质不同却能相互补充或增强的
words.ex: The two methods are different but complementary.
words.ex_cn: 这两种方法不同，但相互补充。
words.en: Distinct yet mutually enhancing elements that together form a cohesive whole.

words.tr: n. 沉淀物；沉淀物 v. 安排( settle的现在分词 )； v. 安家；安排；（使）安定；
words.ex: The settling at the bottom of the jar is normal.
words.ex_cn: 瓶底的沉淀物是正常的。
words.en: The process by which particles suspended in a fluid descend under the influence of gravity to form a sediment, or the act of resolving a dispute or reaching an agreement.

words.tr: v. 解决；决定（ resolve的现在分词 ）；
words.ex: They are resolving the conflict peacefully.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在和平地解决这场冲突。
words.en: The process of finding a solution to a problem or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 不涉及回忆的；不依靠回忆的
words.ex: The task is not involving recollection.
words.ex_cn: 这个任务不涉及回忆。
words.en: Not requiring or based on memory or past experience.

words.tr: phrase. 避免回忆的；回避记忆的
words.ex: He is avoiding recollection of the painful event.
words.ex_cn: 他正在避免回想那件痛苦的事。
words.en: Deliberately not recalling or referencing past events or memories.

words.tr: phrase. 许多社交情境；多种社会背景
words.ex: People use polite words in many social contexts.
words.ex_cn: 人们在许多社交场合使用礼貌用语。
words.en: Various social situations or environments where interactions occur.

words.tr: n. 特征；“characteristic”的复数；
words.ex: The characteristics of this animal include long legs and big ears.
words.ex_cn: 这种动物的特征包括长腿和大耳朵。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 特征；特点；面貌特征；“feature”的复数； v. 以…为特色；
words.ex: The features of this phone are very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的特征非常有用。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr: n. 反应
words.ex: His reaction was quick when the ball came at him.
words.ex_cn: 当球朝他飞来时，他的反应很快。
words.en: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

words.tr: n. 距离；远处；
words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.tr: phrase. 强调与情感；重点和情绪表达
words.ex: He spoke with emphasis and emotion during the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中带着强调和情感说话。
words.en: The act of highlighting something and the feelings associated with it.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 亲密性与即时性；指情感上的亲近感与信息或互动的即时发生
words.ex: They feel intimacy and immediacy when they talk face to face.
words.ex_cn: 当他们面对面交谈时，能感受到亲密和即时性。
words.en: The state of being intimate and the quality of being immediate.

words.tr: phrase. 一个连续体；连续不断的事物或过程
words.ex: The colors form a continuum from red to blue.
words.ex_cn: 这些颜色从红色到蓝色形成一个连续体。
words.en: A continuous, unbroken sequence or range without abrupt divisions.

words.tr: phrase. 互动程度；交互性的等级
words.ex: The game has high degrees of interactivity.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏具有高度的互动性。
words.en: The varying levels of interaction or engagement between participants.

words.tr: phrase. 话语与文本（指语言交流的各种形式，包括口头和书面表达的内容）
words.ex: He reads discourses and texts about ancient philosophy.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读关于古代哲学的论述和文本。
words.en: Systems of language, ideas, and written or spoken communication.

words.tr: phrase. 用法；使用；惯用法
words.ex: The usage of this tool is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的使用非常简单。
words.en: The act or manner of employing something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. + pron. + v. 如何被使用；表示某物或某种方法在实际中的应用方式
words.ex: I don't know how it's used in this program.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道它在这个程序中是如何使用的。
words.en: The way something is utilized or applied in practice.

words.tr: phrase. 用户的目标；使用者的目的
words.ex: The user's goal is to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 用户的目标是快速学习英语。
words.en: The objective or aim that a user is trying to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 用户的目标；使用者的意图
words.ex: His aim is to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是通过考试。
words.en: The goal or objective of the user.

words.tr: phrase. 用户的目的；使用者的意图
words.ex: He knows the user's purpose for using the app.
words.ex_cn: 他知道用户使用这个应用的目的。
words.en: The reason or intention behind a user's actions or choices.

words.tr: phrase. 我们这一物种；人类
words.ex: Our species has lived on Earth for millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 我们的物种已经在地球上生活了数百万年。
words.en: The human race as a collective biological group.

words.tr: n. 人类；“human”的复数；
words.ex: Humans need water to survive.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings collectively; the human race.

words.tr: phrase. 人类
words.ex: Human beings need water to live.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings are members of the species Homo sapiens, characterized by their superior intelligence, articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.tr: phrase. 人类物种；指生物学上的人类，学名为 Homo sapiens
words.ex: The study of the human species includes both physical and cultural aspects.
words.ex_cn: 对人类物种的研究包括身体和文化两个方面。
words.en: The term 'human species' refers to Homo sapiens, the only extant human species. It is characterized by bipedalism, high intelligence, and the capacity for language and complex social structures.

words.tr: n. 智力；情报；
words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: phrase. 向他人学习；借鉴他人经验
words.ex: We can learn from others by listening to their stories.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以通过听别人的故事来向他们学习。
words.en: To gain understanding or skills by observing or interacting with other individuals.

words.tr: v. 重复；重做；
words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.tr: phrase. 他人的智慧；别人的经验与洞见
words.ex: He learned from others wisdom by reading old books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过阅读古籍学习他人的智慧。
words.en: The accumulated knowledge, experience, and insights gained by others over time.

words.tr: phrase. 他人的智慧；别人的聪明才智
words.ex: He listens to other people's wisdom to make better choices.
words.ex_cn: 他听取他人的智慧来做出更好的选择。
words.en: The accumulated insights and prudent judgment gained from the experiences of other people.

words.tr: v. 积累
words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 一种进化上的两难困境，指在生物进化过程中，某些适应性特征可能带来短期优势，但长期来看可能导致物种面临生存危机的矛盾状况
words.ex: The bird faces an evolutionary dilemma: fly higher or stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟面临一个进化困境：飞得更高还是保持安全。
words.en: A situation in which an organism must choose between two or more evolutionary paths, each with significant trade-offs.

words.tr: phrase. 观察他人；注视别人（watching 为动词 watch 的现在分词形式，表示正在观看；others 指其他的人）
words.ex: He likes watching others play soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看别人踢足球。
words.en: The act of observing other people's actions, behaviors, or performances, often for learning, entertainment, or inspiration.

words.tr: 短语：观看他人；观察别人的行为或活动
words.ex: He likes watching other people play games.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看别人玩游戏。
words.en: The act of observing the actions, behaviors, or experiences of other individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 通信系统；通讯系统（指用于传递信息的整套方法或设备）
words.ex: Bees use systems of communication to find food.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂使用交流系统来寻找食物。
words.en: Structured methods and channels for exchanging information between individuals or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 知识与智慧：指通过学习和经验获得的信息与理解（knowledge），以及正确运用这些知识做出明智判断与决策的能力（wisdom）
words.ex: He has knowledge and wisdom from years of reading.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多年的阅读获得了知识和智慧。
words.en: The combination of factual information and insightful understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 合作的好处；协作的优势；共同行动带来的益处
words.ex: The benefits of cooperation are clear in team sports.
words.ex_cn: 合作的好处在团队运动中很明显。
words.en: The positive outcomes or advantages resulting from collaborative efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 身份确立；身份建立；身份认证
words.ex: He is working on identity establishment for his new business.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的新企业建立身份。
words.en: The process of creating or confirming a distinct and consistent self-concept, often in social or professional contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 身份的建立；身份的确认过程
words.ex: The establishment of identities is important for teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 身份的建立对青少年很重要。
words.en: The process of determining or confirming who or what something or someone is, especially in a legal or official context.

words.tr: n. 孤立；隔离；
words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.tr: n. 交流；通信；
words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 不同的语言
words.ex: He speaks different languages.
words.ex_cn: 他会说不同的语言。
words.en: Distinct systems of communication used by different communities, each with its own vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation.

words.tr: phrase. 权力与支配；力量与统治地位
words.ex: He wants power and dominance over his team.
words.ex_cn: 他想要对他的团队拥有权力和支配地位。
words.en: The exercise of control and authority over others, often by force.

words.tr: v. 扩大；扩张；“expand”的现在分词； adj. 扩展的；扩充的；
words.ex: The company is expanding its business to new cities.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在将其业务扩大到新城市。
words.en: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

words.tr: phrase. 开放；开启；敞开心扉；启动（机会、市场等）
words.ex: The country is opening up to foreign investors.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在向外国投资者开放。
words.en: To make something accessible or available; to start or initiate something.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭的；收摊的；停业的
words.ex: The shop is closing up at 9 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 这家店晚上9点关闭。
words.en: The act of shutting or securing something, such as a business or building, for a period of time or permanently.

words.tr: phrase. 相反的事物；对立面
words.ex: Hot is the opposite of cold.
words.ex_cn: 热是冷的反义词。
words.en: The direct contrary or reverse of something, often used to describe a situation, idea, or quality that is completely different from another.

words.tr: adj. 免费赠送的；
words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr: phrase. 占据空间；占用空间
words.ex: The box is occupying space on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子正占着地板上的空间。
words.en: Taking up physical area or volume, often implying a presence that cannot be ignored or easily moved.

words.tr: phrase. +n. 占用房间；占据空间
words.ex: The boxes are occupying room in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子占用了车库里的空间。
words.en: Taking up space in a room, typically in a way that prevents others from using it effectively.

words.tr: n. 支配；优势；控制；
words.ex: His dominance in the game surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的支配表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: Dominance is the state of being more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr: n. 性别；
words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr: n. 性；性别；男性；女性；
words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.tr: phrase. 心智与身体；精神与肉体
words.ex: Exercise helps to strengthen minds and bodies.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于增强心智和身体。
words.en: The mental and physical aspects of a person, often considered together in discussions of health, well-being, or personal development.

words.tr: phrase. 自信的，有把握的，乐观的
words.ex: She is assertive, confident, and optimistic in every meeting.
words.ex_cn: 她在每次会议上都坚定、自信且乐观。
words.en: Boldly self-assured and forceful in expressing opinions or demands.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: phrase. 一次冒险的机会；指具有不确定结果但可能带来高回报的机会
words.ex: Starting that business was a gamble opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 创办那家公司是一次冒险的机会。
words.en: An opportunity involving a risky decision whose outcome is left to chance.

words.tr: phrase. 赌博的机会；可供下注或投机的时机
words.ex: He found many opportunities to gamble in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里找到了很多赌博的机会。
words.en: Chances or occasions to engage in betting or games of chance for money.

words.tr: phrase. 风险承受能力；风险容忍度
words.ex: Understanding your risk tolerance is crucial for making informed investment decisions.
words.ex_cn: 了解你的风险容忍度对于做出明智的投资决策至关重要。
words.en: Risk tolerance refers to the degree of variability in investment returns that an individual is willing to withstand. It is an important concept in the field of finance and investment, as it helps investors make decisions that align with their investment goals and comfort with risk.

words.tr: phrase. 支配性激素；指与支配行为和社会地位相关的激素，如睾酮
words.ex: Testosterone is a dominance hormone in men.
words.ex_cn: 睾酮是男性的一种优势激素。
words.en: A hormone that plays a significant role in establishing and maintaining dominance hierarchies within animal groups.

words.tr: phrase. 应激激素；压力荷尔蒙（指在身体应对压力时分泌的激素，如皮质醇）
words.ex: Cortisol is a stress hormone.
words.ex_cn: 皮质醇是一种压力荷尔蒙。
words.en: A hormone, such as cortisol, released by the adrenal glands in response to stress, preparing the body for a 'fight or flight' reaction.

words.tr: phrase. 自信的，果断的；有信心的；对压力有反应的
words.ex: She is assertive and confident when she speaks in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 她在会议上发言时自信而果断。
words.en: Boldly confident and self-assured in expressing opinions or needs.

words.tr: phrase. 自信的；果断的；坚定的
words.ex: She is assertive when she speaks in class.
words.ex_cn: 她在课堂上发言时很自信。
words.en: Boldly self-assured and confident in expression or action.

words.tr: phrase. 自信的或对压力有反应的
words.ex: He is confident when speaking in public, but stress-reactive during exams.
words.ex_cn: 他在公众演讲时很自信，但在考试时会对压力有反应。
words.en: A person who is either self-assured and certain of their abilities or prone to experiencing heightened anxiety and physical tension in response to stressful situations.

words.tr: phrase. 改变我们的结果或结局
words.ex: We can change our outcomes by working harder.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以通过更努力工作来改变我们的结果。
words.en: To alter or modify our results or consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 改变演出；变更表演方式或内容
words.ex: He changes performances every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都改变表演。
words.en: To alter or modify the way something is performed, especially in a theatrical or public setting.

words.tr: phrase. 改变结果；使结果发生变化
words.ex: He changed the result of the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了数学考试的结果。
words.en: To alter the outcome or final state of something, typically by modifying conditions or actions.

words.tr: 短语动词. 尽力而为；做到最好
words.ex: He does the best he can in every test.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次考试中都尽自己最大的努力。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort in a given situation, often implying a commitment to excellence despite limitations.

words.tr: phrase. 占主导地位的；支配的；主要的
words.ex: The dominant language in the country is English.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的主导语言是英语。
words.en: Most powerful, influential, or prevalent in a particular context or situation.

words.tr: adj. 不充分的；不足的；
words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 不够的
words.ex: There is not enough water for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水不够所有人喝。
words.en: An expression used to indicate that the quantity or degree of something does not meet the required or desired level.

words.tr: n. 管理；条例；规则；
words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr: n. 监督；管理；
words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.tr: phrase. 监管与监督；指通过制定规则（regulation）和持续检查（supervision）来确保合规与安全的系统性管理行为
words.ex: The government has new regulation and supervision for banks.
words.ex_cn: 政府对银行有了新的监管和监督。
words.en: The process of setting rules and monitoring compliance to ensure proper functioning and safety within an organization, industry, or system.

words.tr: phrase. 更多的自由；更大的自由度
words.ex: He has more freedom to choose his own hours.
words.ex_cn: 他有更多自由来选择自己的工作时间。
words.en: Greater liberty to act or make choices without restriction.

words.tr: phrase. 更大的自主权；更多的自治权
words.ex: The students want more autonomy in their learning.
words.ex_cn: 学生们希望在学习中有更多的自主权。
words.en: Increased self-governance or independence in decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的自治权；附加的自主性
words.ex: The school was granted additional autonomy to design its own curriculum.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校被授予了额外的自治权来设计自己的课程。
words.en: Extra authority to manage one's own affairs or operations.

words.tr: n. 工程；工程学；
words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.tr: phrase. 自然科学
words.ex: He likes natural science because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢自然科学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Natural science is a branch of science that deals with the physical world, including physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science.

words.tr: phrase. 农业科学；研究农业生产及其相关领域的学科
words.ex: Agricultural science has revolutionized farming practices.
words.ex_cn: 农业科学彻底改变了耕作方式。
words.en: Agricultural science is the study of the science and technology used in the cultivation and processing of crops and livestock.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 某些领域
words.ex: He has expertise in certain fields of science.
words.ex_cn: 他在某些科学领域具有专业知识。
words.en: Specific areas of study, work, or expertise where specialized knowledge is applied.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 某些学科；特定的纪律或训练领域
words.ex: He studies certain disciplines like math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他学习一些学科，比如数学和科学。
words.en: Specific fields of study or academic subjects.

words.tr: phrase. 更强的市场价值；指资产或公司在市场中具有更高的估值或更强的竞争力
words.ex: The company has a stronger market value this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年的市场价值更强了。
words.en: A term used to describe the increased worth or valuation of a company or asset in the marketplace, often resulting from positive performance, innovation, or market demand.

words.tr: phrase. 高级管理人员工商管理硕士项目；专为有工作经验的专业人士设计的MBA课程
words.ex: He joined an executive MBA program to improve his business skills.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了高级管理人员工商管理硕士课程以提升自己的商业技能。
words.en: Advanced business degree programs for experienced professionals, often part-time.

words.tr: phrase. 外部资助；来自组织或机构外部的拨款或资金支持
words.ex: The school received external grants to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校收到了外部资助来购买新书。
words.en: Funding provided by organizations outside the institution.

words.tr: phrase. 会议中心；举办会议、研讨会等活动的场所
words.ex: The company booked a conference center for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 公司为会议预订了一个会议中心。
words.en: Facilities designed for hosting large events, conventions, or seminars.

words.tr: phrase. 会议中心；会议场所
words.ex: The meeting centers are open every day.
words.ex_cn: 会议中心每天开放。
words.en: Venues specifically equipped for business meetings and corporate gatherings.

words.tr: phrase. 具有市场价值的知识；可转化为商品或服务的实用知识
words.ex: He learned marketable knowledge in his computer course.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机课程中学到了可应用的知识。
words.en: Knowledge or skills that are highly valued and in demand in the job market.

words.tr: phrase. 录取决定；招生决策（指学校或机构对申请者是否被录取的最终决定）
words.ex: The college sent out admissions decisions last week.
words.ex_cn: 大学上周发布了录取决定。
words.en: The process by which educational institutions select which applicants to accept.

words.tr: phrase. 缓慢且不均匀的
words.ex: The clock ticks slow and uneven.
words.ex_cn: 钟表的滴答声缓慢而不均匀。
words.en: Moving or progressing at a low speed with irregular rhythm or pace.

words.tr: phrase. 入学率；注册人数比率
words.ex: The enrollment rates in math classes have gone up.
words.ex_cn: 数学课程的注册率有所上升。
words.en: The percentage or number of individuals who register for an educational institution or program.

words.tr: phrase. 入学率；准入率；录取率
words.ex: The admission rates for the university have gone up this year.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学的录取率今年上升了。
words.en: The percentage or number of individuals accepted into an educational institution or program.

words.tr: phrase. 上大学；就读于高等院校
words.ex: They attend colleges to learn new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他们上大学学习新技能。
words.en: To go to college or university to study.

words.tr: phrase. 支付学费
words.ex: He pays tuition fees every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: To pay the required fees for attending a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 完成大学学业；读完大学
words.ex: He will complete college next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将完成大学学业。
words.en: To successfully finish all required coursework and requirements of a college degree program.

words.tr: phrase. 完成大学学业；从大学毕业
words.ex: He will finish college next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年会大学毕业。
words.en: To successfully finish all required coursework and requirements of a college degree program.

words.tr: phrase. 促进公共目标；推动公共利益目标
words.ex: Governments should promote public goals like clean air and safe streets.
words.ex_cn: 政府应该促进清洁空气和安全街道等公共目标。
words.en: To encourage or support objectives that benefit the general population or society as a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 促进平等；推动平等
words.ex: The school works to promote equality for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校努力促进所有学生的平等。
words.en: To promote equality means to support or encourage the principle that all people should have equal rights and opportunities.

words.tr: n. 经济学家
words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.tr: phrase. 包含一切的，全面的研究；指涵盖所有相关方面或因素的综合性学习或研究
words.ex: This all-inclusive study covers every aspect of climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这项全面的研究涵盖了气候变化的各个方面。
words.en: An all-inclusive study refers to a comprehensive examination or analysis that covers every aspect of a particular subject or topic.

words.tr: pron. 每件事；一切事物；
words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr: n. 研究；学习；“study”的复数； v. 研究；学习；
words.ex: His studies show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的研究显示睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The act of learning or acquiring knowledge, especially from books or through systematic investigation.

words.tr: phrase. 重复且乏味的；单调而枯燥的
words.ex: The work is repetitive and tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复而乏味。
words.en: Occurring repeatedly and lacking interest, excitement, or variety.

words.tr: phrase. 重复且乏味的；单调无趣的
words.ex: The movie was repeated and dull, so I left early.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影重复且乏味，所以我提前离开了。
words.en: Occurring repeatedly and lacking interest, excitement, or variety.

words.tr: phrase. 重复且乏味的；一再重复且令人厌倦的
words.ex: The movie was repeated and boring, so I left early.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影重复且乏味，所以我提前离开了。
words.en: Occurring repeatedly and lacking interest, excitement, or variety.

words.tr: phrase. 理想社会；指人们所向往的完美或最适宜的社会形态
words.ex: He dreams of the ideal society where everyone is happy.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想着一个每个人都很幸福的理想社会。
words.en: A conception of a society that is perfect in terms of justice, fairness, and equality for all its members.

words.tr: phrase. 非西方人民；非西方国家的人；指来自亚洲、非洲、拉丁美洲等非欧美文化背景的人群
words.ex: Non-western people often have different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 非西方人通常有不同的传统。
words.en: People from cultures or societies not originating in Western Europe or North America.

words.tr: phrase. 其他人；别人
words.ex: He always considers other people's feelings before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定之前总是会考虑别人的感受。
words.en: Individuals other than oneself; fellow human beings.

words.tr: phrase. 其他国家；其他民族
words.ex: Other nations have different laws.
words.ex_cn: 其他国家有不同的法律。
words.en: Countries or states other than one's own; foreign countries.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: phrase. 检查化石；对化石进行仔细观察
words.ex: Scientists are examining the fossils in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在实验室里检查这些化石。
words.en: The act of studying the preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms.

words.tr: phrase. 化石的检查或检验；对化石进行的详细审查或分析
words.ex: The scientists are doing fossils examination in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正在沙漠中进行化石检查。
words.en: The study or inspection of fossils to understand ancient life forms and environments.

words.tr: phrase. 检查化石；研究化石以了解古代生物和地质历史
words.ex: Archaeologists often examine fossils to understand ancient life forms.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家经常研究化石以了解古代生命形式。
words.en: To study the preserved remains or traces of ancient organisms in a systematic way.

words.tr: phrase. 习得行为；通过学习获得的行为模式
words.ex: Learned behavior can be observed in animals when they adapt to their environment through training.
words.ex_cn: 通过训练，动物适应环境的行为可以被观察到，这就是学习行为。
words.en: A behavior acquired through observation or instruction rather than through innate instinct.

words.tr: phrase. 人类的镜子；映照人性的镜子；人类学著作《Mirror for Man》的标题
words.ex: Literature serves as a mirror for man, reflecting the complexities of human nature and society.
words.ex_cn: 文学作为人类之镜，反映了人性和社会的复杂性。
words.en: A metaphorical concept suggesting humans can understand themselves by observing their own species.

words.tr: n. 语言学
words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手资料
words.ex: Journalists always seek the firsthand information to ensure the accuracy of their reports.
words.ex_cn: 记者总是寻求第一手资料以确保他们报道的准确性。
words.en: Original and direct information obtained from the source or through personal experience.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手的实地工作；直接参与的田野调查
words.ex: The anthropologist collected firsthand fieldwork data in remote villages.
words.ex_cn: 人类学家在偏远村庄收集了第一手的实地工作数据。
words.en: Research conducted directly in the natural environment where the subject exists, rather than in a laboratory.

words.tr: phrase. 个性与情感；性格与感受
words.ex: The book explores the intricate relationship between personality and feelings.
words.ex_cn: 这本书探讨了个性与情感之间复杂的关系。
words.en: The combination of distinctive traits, emotional states, and characteristic patterns of thought and behavior of an individual.

words.tr: phrase. 两种性别（通常指男性和女性）
words.ex: The study focuses on the differences between two sexes.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究聚焦于两性之间的差异。
words.en: The two biological categories (male and female) into which many species are divided.

words.tr: phrase. 雄性与雌性；男性和女性
words.ex: The study compared males and females in terms of behavior.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究比较了雄性与雌性的行为。
words.en: Males and females refer to the two sexes of a species, typically distinguished by their reproductive roles and physical characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 男性与女性
words.ex: Men and women work together in this office.
words.ex_cn: 男女在这个办公室一起工作。
words.en: Men and women refers to the adult human males and females collectively.

words.tr: phrase. 实际应用；实践运用
words.ex: The practical application of this theory is still being explored.
words.ex_cn: 这一理论的实际应用仍在探索中。
words.en: The use of a method or idea in a real situation or context.

words.tr: phrase. 解决人类的问题
words.ex: The new policy aims to solve human problems related to poverty and unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 新政策旨在解决与贫困和失业相关的人类问题。
words.en: To find solutions to issues affecting human beings, often through scientific, social, or technological means.

words.tr: phrase. 找到解决办法；找出解决方案
words.ex: We need to find solutions to these problems as soon as possible.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要尽快找到这些问题的解决办法。
words.en: Discovering answers or methods to problems or challenges.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr: phrase. 抽象的；非具体的；不涉及具体细节的
words.ex: The painting shows anything abstract, like shapes and colors without real objects.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了抽象的东西，比如没有真实物体的形状和颜色。
words.en: Any concept, idea, or entity that is not physical or concrete.

words.tr: phrase. 抽象的事物；不具体的、概念化的存在
words.ex: Children find abstract things hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们觉得抽象的东西很难理解。
words.en: Concepts, ideas, or entities that are not physical or tangible.

words.tr: phrase. 某种抽象的事物；抽象概念
words.ex: He couldn't understand something abstract like infinity.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解像无限这样的抽象事物。
words.en: A concept, idea, or thing that is not physical or concrete.

words.tr: phrase. 别的东西；另一回事
words.ex: He solved the problem using something else.
words.ex_cn: 他用别的方法解决了这个问题。
words.en: used to refer to a different or additional thing or person

words.tr: n. 相似；类推；类似( analogy的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He used analogies to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用相似来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: Comparisons between two different things to highlight similarities, often used to explain complex ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 类比网络；由多个类比关系交织而成的结构体系
words.ex: The scientist used networks of analogies to explain complex concepts in a more understandable way.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用类比网络以更易理解的方式解释复杂概念。
words.en: Interconnected systems of comparisons that help explain or understand complex concepts.

words.tr: phrase. 生动的理解；清晰而鲜明的理解
words.ex: She has a vivid understanding of the situation.
words.ex_cn: 她对形势有着清晰的认识。
words.en: A clear, detailed, and emotionally resonant grasp of a subject or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 模式识别；图样识别；模式辨认
words.ex: Pattern recognition is a key component in many machine learning algorithms.
words.ex_cn: 模式识别是许多机器学习算法中的关键组成部分。
words.en: The ability to identify and interpret patterns, structures, or regularities in data or information.

words.tr: adj. 不同的
words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.tr: phrase. 色听；一种联觉现象，指听到声音时会同时感知到颜色
words.ex: Colored hearing is a phenomenon where sounds are perceived as having colors.
words.ex_cn: 色听是一种声音被感知为有颜色的现象。
words.en: A form of synesthesia where hearing sounds evokes the perception of colors.

words.tr: phrase. 字面意义；按字面理解的含义
words.ex: The literal meaning of 'break a leg' is not to hurt your leg.
words.ex_cn: 'break a leg' 的字面意思不是摔断腿。
words.en: The most basic, direct, and non-figurative sense of a word or phrase.

words.tr: phrase. 把隐喻视为虚假的；将比喻当作不真实的说法
words.ex: The argument that metaphors as false can mislead people is widely debated.
words.ex_cn: n. 比喻作为虚假的会误导人们的观点被广泛讨论。
words.en: The concept that metaphors can be misleading or false in their representation.

words.tr: phrase. 错误的隐喻；指那些在逻辑、语义或文化上不恰当、不合理或产生误解的比喻表达
words.ex: The use of false metaphors can lead to misunderstandings in communication.
words.ex_cn: 使用错误的比喻可能会导致沟通中的误解。
words.en: A metaphor that is inaccurate or misleading, often used to convey a false idea.

words.tr: phrase. 隐喻意义；比喻含义
words.ex: The poet used the rose as a symbol of love, exploring the metaphorical meaning behind it.
words.ex_cn: 诗人用玫瑰作为爱的象征，探讨了其背后的隐喻意义。
words.en: The metaphorical meaning refers to the symbolic or figurative significance of a word, phrase, or concept, beyond its literal interpretation.

words.tr: phrase. 更高的期望；更高的预期
words.ex: After winning the regional championship, the team now faces higher expectations for the national tournament.
words.ex_cn: 在赢得地区冠军后，球队现在面临着全国锦标赛的更高期望。
words.en: A level of demand or standards that is greater than what was previously held.

words.tr: phrase. 影响决策；左右决定
words.ex: Her presentation was very persuasive, effectively influencing decisions at the board meeting.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲非常有说服力，有效地影响了董事会会议上的决策。
words.en: The act or power of affecting, guiding, or altering decisions or outcomes by some means.

words.tr: phrase. 干预主义者的建议；主张政府或外部力量介入的推荐意见
words.ex: The interventionist recommendations were met with mixed reactions from the public.
words.ex_cn: n. 这些干预主义的建议在公众中引起了不同的反应。
words.en: Recommendations that advocate or involve intervention, especially by a government in economic affairs.

words.tr: n. 介入；干涉；干预；介入，干涉，干预( intervention的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The teacher made quick interventions to help students understand.
words.ex_cn: 老师迅速介入以帮助学生理解。
words.en: Actions or strategies designed to alter a situation or behavior, often in education or health.

words.tr: phrase. 已知的与未知的；被了解的和未被了解的
words.ex: In science, we explore both the known and unknown to expand our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 在科学中，我们探索已知和未知的事物，以扩展我们的理解。
words.en: Things that are already recognized and understood versus those that are not yet discovered or comprehended.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉陌生的；对不熟悉的事物有所了解的
words.ex: He is familiar with unfamiliar situations.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉陌生的环境。
words.en: adj. well known from long or close association | adj. not known or well known

words.tr: adj. 到处存在的
words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她到处找她的钥匙。
words.en: in or to all places

words.tr: adj. 自然的；天然的；
words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr: phrase. 语言机制；语言运作机制；语言系统内部各组成部分相互作用的方式
words.ex: The study of language mechanism helps to understand how humans process and produce speech.
words.ex_cn: 语言机制的研究有助于理解人类如何处理和产生言语。
words.en: The cognitive and linguistic processes that enable the understanding and production of language.

words.tr: phrase. 具体的规则；特定的规定
words.ex: The specific rules of the game must be followed to ensure fairness.
words.ex_cn: n. 必须遵守游戏的具体规则以确保公平。
words.en: The particular regulations or guidelines that are clearly defined and must be adhered to in a given context.

words.tr: phrase. 词序；语序（指句子中词语的排列顺序）
words.ex: The word order in this sentence is incorrect.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子中的词序不正确。
words.en: The sequence in which words are arranged in a sentence to convey meaning according to grammatical rules.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr: phrase. 年幼的儿童；年纪较小的孩子们
words.ex: Younger children often look up to their older siblings.
words.ex_cn: 更小的孩子常常仰望他们的哥哥姐姐。
words.en: Children who are relatively young, typically in early childhood or primary school age.

words.tr: phrase. 有意识的教学；指教师在教学过程中自觉地、有目的地进行教学设计与实施
words.ex: The teacher uses conscious teaching to help every student learn.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师使用有意识的教学来帮助每个学生学习。
words.en: The deliberate and focused instruction of language concepts and skills to learners.

words.tr: n. 自信心
words.ex: He has self-confidence when he speaks in public.
words.ex_cn: 他当众讲话时很有自信。
words.en: Self-confidence is the belief in one's own abilities and judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 低焦虑；焦虑程度低
words.ex: The therapy helped her achieve a low anxiety state, allowing her to focus better on her daily tasks.
words.ex_cn: 这种疗法帮助她达到了低焦虑状态，使她能更好地专注于日常任务。
words.en: A state of minimal stress or nervousness, conducive to effective learning.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.tr: phrase. 更重要的；更为重要的
words.ex: More important, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 更重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: Comparative form of important; used to indicate that something is of greater significance or value than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 学习速度；学习速率
words.ex: His learning speed is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的学习速度非常快。
words.en: The rate at which a person acquires new knowledge or skills.

words.tr: phrase. 真实的、原汁原味的语言；指自然、地道、非人为编造的语言使用形式
words.ex: The movie uses authentic language spoken by local people.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影使用了当地人说的原汁原味的语言。
words.en: Language used in real-life contexts, as opposed to artificial or textbook examples.

words.tr: phrase. 更艰难的过程；更困难的程序
words.ex: Learning to ride a bike is a harder process than learning to walk.
words.ex_cn: 学习骑自行车是一个比学习走路更艰难的过程。
words.en: A more difficult or challenging procedure or series of actions.

words.tr: adj. 机械的；无思想的；
words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.
